title: Geometry Component Plan v1
description: Structural schema for one GeometryComponentPlan entry inside a GeometryPlan. See docs/bible/08-alchemist/166-geometry-plan-model.md and 167-geometry-plan-generation.md. This is a PLANNED abstraction — no such object is materialized anywhere in the current backend; component construction parameters are computed inline, at the top of each build_* function, not as a separate upfront plan.

canonicalName.description: e.g. "band", "prongs" — matches the current GeneratedComponent.name values exactly.

dependencies.description: Other componentPlanIds this one's build operation reads derived values from, e.g. prongs and basket_support both depend on the same prong_center_radius derivation that stone.diameter feeds.

buildOperation.description: A human-readable name for the construction strategy, e.g. "revolve_flat_profile", "revolve_comfort_fit_profile", "loft_stone_reference", "extrude_prong_cylinder", "cut_basket_shell".

directParameters.description: JDL field values copied straight through, e.g. band.width, band.thickness.

derivedParameters.description: Values computed before construction, e.g. inner_radius, outer_radius, prong_center_radius, band_top_z.

coordinatePlacement.description: PLANNED — no component plan currently records an explicit placement separate from the derived parameters used inline during construction; see docs/bible/07-atlas/125-transformations.md.

required.description: CURRENT: all four solitaire components are required; none is optional.

fallbackPolicy.description: e.g. "fallback_to_unfilleted_solid" (band), "fallback_to_compound" (assembly-level fuse, not a single component's own policy), "none" (stone, prongs, basket).

inspectionRequirements.description: checkType values from specs/atlas/v1/geometry-inspection-result.schema.json this component plan expects to be checked.
